    Frequently Asked Questions

    What is the most comfortable type of mattress?

    +
    Most comfortable mattress is entirely dependent on your sleeping style and choice. The memory foam and latex mattresses provide great support and pressure relief, while orthopedic mattresses offer proper spinal alignment. At Penguin Sleep, we have a range of mattresses that will cater to your comfort requirements.

    Can the mattress be used on both sides?

    +
    Some mattresses are designed for dual-sided use, offering different levels of firmness on both sides. However, many of the modern mattresses, such as ortho zen and memory foam, are single-sided and should be used as per instructions given, as this will ensure durability and full comfort.

    Does the mattress come with a removable cover?

    +
    Yes, most of our mattresses come with a washable and removable cover, making it easy to maintain hygiene and keep your mattress clean. While buying a mattress online, always review the product specifications to ensure whether the feature exists or not for the selected mattress.

    How can I check delivery availability?

    +
    You can check the delivery availability of your mattress by entering your PIN code on the product page at Wooden Street. Our system will show estimated delivery time and availability on the basis of your location.

    What makes this mattress unique?

    +
    Mattresses at Penguin Sleep are crafted with high-quality materials such as memory foam, latex, and advanced spring systems. They will provide you with superior comfort, durability, and orthopedic support, which will ultimately ensure a restful sleep. In addition to this, they come in various levels of firmness that will match your sleeping preferences.

    How should I maintain and clean the mattress?

    +
    To maintain your mattress in a clean and durable condition, vacuum it regularly to get rid of dust and allergens. For spills, use a mild detergent and spot clean softly. Let the mattress air out in a well-ventilated area to avoid moisture accumulation. You can also use a mattress protector, as it protects from spills and dust, keeping the mattress fresh and hygienic.

    How does the contouring support of this mattress help reduce stiffness in joints & help with spinal alignment?

    +
    The mattress adapts to your body shape, ensuring even weight distribution and pressure relief on joints. The ergonomic nature of the Dream Lux mattress ensures spinal alignment, reducing stiffness while providing a comfortable sleep.

    Can this mattress be used on any bed frame?

    +
    Yes, Dream Lux Mattress is compatible with most bed frames; this includes platform beds, box springs, and adjustable bases. A sturdy and even surface is recommended to ensure you get optimal support and durability.

    Does the mattress trap heat?

    +
    No, the mattress uses breathable components that allow for airflow and temperature regulation. The ventilated foam layers and cooling gel help in the dispersion of heat, which will provide a comfortable and cool sleeping environment.
